reason: The patch adds an org.hamcrest:hamcrest test-scope dependency to authz/client/pom.xml (patch lines 15-19), but ECDSAAlgorithmTest.java, the only test file in the module, imports only org.junit.Assert and org.junit.Test (lines 649-650).
